text:
```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bash environment
        run: |
          chmod +x ./tests/*.sh
          chmod +x ./src/*.sh

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          bash ./tests/run_tests.sh
```
